purpose: Make suicide and overdose aftermath legible as a protected postvention subcube without admitting method detail, scene detail, public case detail, stigma, blame, or advice.
governing_line: The archive can name the harm-cloud after suicide and overdose only by refusing the details that make that cloud worse.

clusters.job: Name suicide and overdose aftermath as high-gate postvention fields.
Hold method silence, note-content silence, non-sensational language, and single-cause refusal.
Make grief, support routing, anniversary reopening, and worker burden visible without becoming therapy.
Protect child, school, workplace, team, and community postvention language.
Separate overdose bereavement, stigma, toxicology/cause-manner vocabulary, naloxone guilt, peer grief, and memorial pressure.
Prevent phones, messages, photos, belongings, and room condition from becoming public spectacle.

publication_posture: all records quarantined; no public postvention surface enabled
